content.text: The build toolchain is blocked by the sandbox (`~/.cargo` and `~/.rustup` are unreadable). Let me verify the algorithm using `awk`, which does work here:

input.command:
awk 'function is_pal(s,   n,t,i,a,b,c){t="";for(i=1;i<=length(s);i++){c=substr(s,i,1);if(c ~ /[[:alnum:]]/)t=t tolower(c)}n=length(t);for(i=1;i<=int(n/2);i++){a=substr(t,i,1);b=substr(t,n-i+1,1);if(a!=b){printf "%-34s norm=%-24s -> FALSE\n","\""s"\"",(t==""?"(empty)":t);return 0}}printf "%-34s norm=%-24s -> TRUE\n","\""s"\"",(t==""?"(empty)":t);return 1}
BEGIN{split("racecar|A man a plan a canal Panama|hello|Rats live on no evil star|Was it a car or a cat I saw?|No x in Nixon|Able was I ere I saw Elba!|ab|a|Hello, World!|",cs,"|");for(k in cs)is_pal(cs[k])}'
